Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integracom SDK/API integration & roadblock triage

Hi Alex / Priya —

Quick weekly MAP check-in from our side. Attached is an updated MAP worksheet (redwood-map-v2.xlsx) with dates pushed for the auth and streaming milestones. High-level status:

- SDK integration: in progress (SDK PR open, unit tests pending) — owner: Dev Patel
- API auth: blocker — Integracom intermittent token validation failures reported by staging — owner: Integracom infra (Alex)
- Streaming & tool-calling: prototype working, needs KV-cache performance tuning — owner: Rishi
- Evaluation plan: we’ll run the 50k-turn eval in the QA sandbox next Wed (3/24) if auth is resolved.

Immediate asks:
1) Alex — can you confirm the root cause for the token validation failures and an ETA for a fix (we need auth stable by 3/23 to keep the eval cadence)?
2) Dev — please attach the small auth snippet you mentioned and a short note on how to apply it in their test harness.
3) Rishi / Monica — list any test-data or helper endpoints you need from Integracom to run streaming load tests.

I’ve attached the MAP (redwood-map-v2.xlsx). I’ll follow up with a short triage call if we hit the auth deadline.

Thanks —
Camila
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@integracom.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Priya Saini <priya.saini@integracom.com>, Infrastructure Team <infra@integracom.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-03-16 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integracom SDK/API integration & roadblock triage

Camila — thanks for the note. Short update from infra side:

- Root cause: an edge case in our token refresh handler where a 401 from one upstream gets propagated without retry logic. That shows up intermittently under parallel requests from your SDK test suite.
- ETA: we have a patch queued for tomorrow morning (3/17) and will deploy to staging by EOD.
- Temporary mitigation: we can flip an env var to force conservative refresh (will add ~50ms latency) — if you want to proceed with eval in QA we can enable that as a stopgap.

Will confirm after staging deploy. If staging looks good, we can target 3/23 for production-like sandbox.

—Alex
Alex Chen, Senior Infra Eng — Integracom

- All unit tests pass locally (coverage unchanged).
- Smoke test against Integracom staging (with Alex's conservative refresh env var enabled) succeeded for 2000 calls in ~18s.

Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — Integracom SDK/API integration & roadblock triage

Short status before the close-of-week sync:
- Streaming load tests started this morning against the sandbox; initial run (5k turns) shows KV-cache eviction causing ~12% latency tail spikes at p99.
- Hypothesis: cache window too small for the workload pattern; will instrument with +20% KV-cache and rerun at noon.
- Request to Integracom: please confirm /stream/start, /stream/ping, /stream/stop exist and that sandbox will accept 10k parallel connections for the next 48h. Alex — can you confirm?

If Integracom can confirm parallel connections and the conservative auth refresh stays enabled, we should be able to run the full 50k eval on 3/24 as planned. If not, we should re-scope to a reduced-eval and adjust the MAP dates (see attached MAP sheet).

Thanks —
Rishi
Principal Engineer, Inference Runtime — Redwood Inference
